label: Bible Study
prompt: Faithful are the _____ of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
verse: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
note: An honest friend's sting beats an enemy's flattering kisses.

label: Warm-Up Word
note: Two words, one standing order: Rejoice evermore — no expiration date on the joy.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he took him a _____ to scrape himself withal; and he sat down among the ashes.
verse: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal; and he sat down among the ashes.
note: Stripped of everything, Job sat in the ashes scraping his sores with a broken piece of pottery.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and _____ you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
verse: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
note: Disciples don't apply for the job: Jesus did the choosing and appointing — for fruit that lasts.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Let nothing be done through strife or _____; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
verse: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
note: 'Vainglory' is empty glory, conceit. Paul's cure: lowliness of mind, each esteeming others better than himself.
